SELECT     IV.INVid, IV.INV_date, IV.draft_INV, IV.draft_INVdate, IV.ref_orderid, IV.ref_order_date, IV.status_approve, IND.status_kit, IND.productid, ISNULL(CONVERT(int, REPLACE(IND.qty_V, ',', '')), 0) AS qty_V,
                          (SELECT     ISNULL(SUM(CONVERT(int, REPLACE(dbo.CreditNote_Detail.qty_CN, ',', ''))), 0) AS qty_CN
                            FROM          dbo.CreditNote INNER JOIN
                                                   dbo.CreditNote_Detail ON dbo.CreditNote.draft_CN = dbo.CreditNote_Detail.draft_CN
                            WHERE      (dbo.CreditNote.status_approve = N'1') AND (dbo.CreditNote_Detail.productid = IND.productid) AND (dbo.CreditNote.ref_INV = IV.INVid)) AS qty_CN
FROM         dbo.INVOICE AS IV INNER JOIN
                      dbo.INVOICE_Detail AS IND ON IV.draft_INV = IND.draft_INV
WHERE     (IV.status_approve NOT IN (N'2', N'5'))
UNION
SELECT     IV.INVid, IV.INV_date, IV.draft_INV, IV.draft_INVdate, IV.ref_orderid, IV.ref_order_date, IV.status_approve, IND.status_kit, IND.productid, ISNULL(CONVERT(int, REPLACE(IND.qty_V, ',', '')), 0) AS qty_V,
                          (SELECT     ISNULL(SUM(CONVERT(int, REPLACE(dbo.CreditNote_Detail_kit.qty_cn, ',', ''))), 0) AS qty_CN
                            FROM          dbo.CreditNote INNER JOIN
                                                   dbo.CreditNote_Detail_kit ON dbo.CreditNote.draft_CN = dbo.CreditNote_Detail_kit.draft_CN
                            WHERE      (dbo.CreditNote.status_approve = N'1') AND (dbo.CreditNote_Detail_kit.productid = IND.productid) AND (dbo.CreditNote.ref_INV = IV.INVid)) AS qty_CN
FROM         dbo.INVOICE AS IV INNER JOIN
                      dbo.INVOICE_Detail_kit AS IND ON IV.draft_INV = IND.draft_INV
WHERE     (IV.status_approve NOT IN (N'2', N'5'))
views.V_Order_total:
AS
SELECT        dbo.Order_a.orderid, dbo.Order_a.order_date, dbo.Order_a.status_approve, ISNULL(OD.panelid, N'') AS panelid, ISNULL(OD.productid, N'') AS productid, ISNULL(OD.product_barcode, N'') AS product_barcode, 
                         ISNULL(OD.brand, N'') AS brand, ISNULL(OD.catno, N'') AS catno, ISNULL(OD.size, N'') AS size, ISNULL(OD.unit, N'') AS unit, ISNULL(OD.description, N'') AS description, CONVERT(int, 
                         REPLACE(ISNULL(OD.qty_order_nokit, N'0'), ',', '')) AS qty_order_nokit, CONVERT(int, REPLACE(ISNULL(OD.qty_order_kit, N'0'), ',', '')) AS qty_order_kit, ISNULL(OD.saleuniten, N'') AS saleuniten, 
                         ISNULL(OD.saleunitth, N'') AS saleunitth, ISNULL(OD.status_kit, N'') AS status_kit, CONVERT(int, REPLACE(ISNULL(OD.qty_order_nokit, N'0'), ',', '')) + CONVERT(int, REPLACE(ISNULL(OD.qty_order_kit, N'0'), ',', '')) 
                         AS total_qty_order, ISNULL
                             ((SELECT        SUM(qty_V) AS Expr1
                                 FROM            dbo.V_for_Invoice AS VF WITH (nolock)
                                 WHERE        (ref_orderid = dbo.Order_a.orderid) AND (status_kit = OD.status_kit) AND (productid = OD.productid)), 0) AS sum_qty_invoice, ISNULL
                             ((SELECT        SUM(qty_CN) AS Expr1
                                 FROM            dbo.V_for_Invoice AS VF WITH (nolock)
                                 WHERE        (ref_orderid = dbo.Order_a.orderid) AND (status_kit = OD.status_kit) AND (productid = OD.productid)), 0) AS sum_qty_creditnote

                         dbo.V_Order_detail_all AS OD WITH (nolock) ON dbo.Order_a.orderid = OD.orderid

report_mapping.title: Order
report_mapping.layout: Logo left, company identity right; customer and delivery blocks left/centre; order, date, salesperson, department, manager and area right. Parent and component lines; totals beneath items. Two pages repeat the header and grid headings.
report_mapping.footer: Terms and customer / creator / approver signatures on continuation page.
report_mapping.caveat: Use stored document snapshots. Do not print every kit component as a separately priced sale. Customer PO and quotation references must remain traceable even if not visible on this sample.

report_mapping.title: Invoice
report_mapping.layout: Same three-block commercial header; ten-column item grid; indented kit components. Total, sales discount, cash discount, total amount, VAT and grand total at right beneath grid.
report_mapping.footer: Creator and approver signatures on page 2 with repeated document header. Customer PO / remarks under totals.
report_mapping.caveat: The sample has a second signature page even with few lines; treat pagination as an explicit template rule to verify, not permission to omit the page.

report_mapping.title: Credit Note
report_mapping.layout: Customer and delivery snapshots, credit-note number/date, salesperson, department, manager and area. Ten-column grid with separate credit destinations.
report_mapping.footer: Remarks and six-line totals block followed by creator / approver signatures.
report_mapping.caveat: Ref. invoice comes from ref_INV/ref_INV_date. Credit value, physical returns, deposit reduction and reborrowing are distinct effects.

report_mapping.title: Purchase Order
report_mapping.layout: Supplier block left; PO, date, Kindly Ship On, payment term and Ship via right. Brand grouping; seven-column item grid with currency in price headings.
report_mapping.footer: Total, Discount, Total Amount, VAT and Total F.O.B.; shipping remarks; authorized signatory near foot.
report_mapping.caveat: Use po_currency / currency_buy; never hard-code THB or a 7% VAT rate. Approver identity and position are document data.

report_mapping.title: Total Confirm Purchase Order
report_mapping.layout: Compact supplier header; PO number/date, confirmation count and latest confirmation number/date right; brand grouping. This is a PO-level cumulative summary, not a single confirmation print.
report_mapping.caveat: Confirm count, grouping and latest confirmation must reproduce report queries. The supplied view uses MAX on text dates/IDs and joins by PO/product/buyunit; reconcile repeated confirmations before translating. Do not blindly sum already cumulative quantities.

report_mapping.title: Temporary Order
report_mapping.layout: Company header; customer block and Borrow No./Borrow Date/Area ID; parent kit with indented components; delivery-to block adjoining totals.
report_mapping.footer: Total/discounts/net/VAT/grand total, remarks, customer and authorized signatory with date blanks.
report_mapping.caveat: Temporary Order is the report title for Borrowing. Printed title differs from the menu label; do not rename the input function.

report_mapping.title: Product Returns
report_mapping.layout: Customer block; Return ID/date, TD ID/date and Borrow ID/date right. Kit components and nested lot/expiry/quantity rows.
report_mapping.footer: Return reason; totals; customer and receiver signature/date blanks.
report_mapping.caveat: Sample shows 94,534.50 net + 7,115.50 VAT = 101,650.00, while 7% of net is 6,617.415. The displayed line amount is also 101,650.00. Reconcile stored rb_* totals, VAT mode and original report expressions; do not silently correct or reproduce this as a universal formula.

report_mapping.title: Withdrawal
report_mapping.layout: Company/customer header; Withdrawal ID/date, Ref. Invoice ID/date, area. Simple five-column unpriced grid. Delivery contact beneath grid.
report_mapping.caveat: Filename says DO, but the visible title is Withdrawal. Route by the report content, not filename. This is not the warehouse Delivery Out report.

report_mapping.title: Delivery Order
report_mapping.layout: Company/customer header; DO ID/date, invoice reference, shipment date, area, delivery by. Unpriced grid with kit subrows and lot/expiry lines.
report_mapping.footer: Delivery-to contact panel; receiver and shipper signature/date blanks.
report_mapping.caveat: Customer Delivery Order and internal Delivery Out are separate layouts. DO_id/DO_date differ from stockoutid/date_out. Preserve automatic shipment from Check Out in the current workflow.

report_mapping.title: Delivery In
report_mapping.layout: Compact operational header with stock-in ID, dates, reference type/ID, credit note and barcode. Banded parent/component rows; conditions/origin on secondary rows; lot-level detail.
report_mapping.footer: Comment; Check In By and Submit By signatures; timestamp and Page x of y.
report_mapping.caveat: Use real check-in quantities and status codes. One generic qty field cannot stand for ordered, entered and scanned quantities simultaneously. Barcode symbology is not established by the PDF alone.

report_mapping.title: Delivery Out
report_mapping.layout: Compact header with stock-out ID/date, source type/ID/date, TD, DO and invoice references; barcode and status right. Parent and component rows, lot-level cost/sale-unit details.
report_mapping.footer: Comment, Check Out By and Submit By signatures; timestamp and page count.
report_mapping.caveat: Sample status reads “Pending to Check In” although this is outbound and rows say Complete. Verify status expression; do not assume active/status_ship/checkout flags have the same meaning.

report_mapping.title: Check Stock
report_mapping.layout: Check ID/date/type, Stocked status, checker and adjuster. Product group totals followed by location, lot and expiry subrows with balance/count quantities.
report_mapping.caveat: This filename is a stock-count report, not a stock-out location listing. Approval must post only verified variance at location/lot level, not the entire counted quantity.

report_mapping.title: Move Stock
report_mapping.layout: Move ID/date and operator; seven-column grid. Both location cells expand building, floor, rack and detail; product cell expands brand/cat/size/description.
report_mapping.caveat: A location-to-location move is not a fresh receipt or dispatch. Preserve source/destination location IDs and reconcile net zero company stock movement.
